cases.question: I am travelling and Netflix says this TV is not part of my household. What should I do?

sources.conditions: Travelling; country and device conditions apply
sources.locale: en; country condition must be reviewed

sources.conditions: Household update from primary home internet when required
sources.locale: en; country condition must be reviewed

sources.conditions: Use the device-specific option shown; TV travel codes require non-Kids profile, account-owner contact and available code requests
sources.locale: en; country condition must be reviewed

cases.reference: For an account owner's TV away from home, use the displayed I'm Traveling option if available from a non-Kids profile. Request the temporary code through the account owner's email; text is an alternative when no email is on file. Enter the four-digit code on the TV before its 15-minute expiry. Device/account issues and request limits may prevent this option. A primary-home Household update is a separate conditional path, not a required action for every trip.
requiredFacts: Choose the applicable TV travel option rather than automatically relocating the Household
Account-owner verification; text alternative is conditional
Distinguish code expiry from duration of viewing access
Respect unavailable options, profile and request-limit conditions

cases.question: My account is billed in another country, household verification fails, and I cannot access my original email. What should I do?

sources.conditions: Household update from primary home internet when required
sources.locale: en; country condition must be reviewed

sources.conditions: Only actual relocation warrants changing membership country; travelling is different
sources.locale: en; country condition must be reviewed

sources.conditions: SMS reset requires a phone number already linked to the account; account/contact recovery remains conditional
sources.locale: en; country condition must be reviewed

sources.conditions: Official support contact; no connection or account mutation is implied
sources.locale: en; country condition must be reviewed

sources.conditions: Use the device-specific option shown; TV travel codes require non-Kids profile, account-owner contact and available code requests
sources.locale: en; country condition must be reviewed

cases.reference: First distinguish relocation from temporary travel. For an actual move to another country, Netflix's membership-country procedure is to cancel, wait until membership ends and restart in the new country. Household updates apply to the primary home internet. If the original email is inaccessible, SMS password reset requires an already-linked phone number; otherwise use official Netflix account-recovery support. Do not collect payment credentials in this chatbot or promise account changes.
requiredFacts: Distinguish relocation from temporary travel
Country change: cancel, wait until membership ends, restart in new country
Household: primary home internet
SMS reset requires already-linked phone number
Use official support if account contact methods are inaccessible
No real mutation or sensitive credential collection
